split: Retained original 90/10 row split, split seed 42; training seeds vary, split stays fixed
architecture: Released miRBind pair CNN: 18 pair states projected to 8; filters 128,64,32; kernels 6,3,3; dropout 0.2
control: Permute complete A/C/G/T score quartets only within scored positions sharing the same reference nucleotide. Fixed permutation from axis, visible sequence, missingness mask and control seed 20260906; reused across splits and training seeds.
interpretation: Real versus shuffled tests positional assignment within each reference-base class. Guide identity, profile distribution and coverage remain available. Seed repeats measure training variability under a fixed development split; they do not supply independent external validation.
historical_results: Prior seed-42 results remain descriptive references and are not counted among the three fresh matched seeds.
evaluation_policy: Test and left-out predictions exported only after validation selects a checkpoint. Report every planned condition and seed; no condition selection based on evaluation results.
source_change: Models and training loop copied unchanged. Compact input tensors retained in CPU memory; full-data epoch permutations match released loader. Smoke subsets use 512 rows per class and are excluded from research results.
